# larpings.com — LLM context

## What this site is
larpings.com is a peer-to-peer marketplace for buying, selling, and trading rare social media handles, usernames, accounts, fansigns, and creator services. All transactions use crypto escrow for protection.

## Supported platforms
Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), Snapchat, Telegram, YouTube, Discord

## Key pages
- / — Homepage, featured listings
- /marketplace — Full inventory with filters by platform and category
- /fansigns — Fansign orders from creators
- /sell — List an item for sale
- /legit — Legitimacy checks and escrow info
- /about — About larpings.com
- /blog — News and guides
- /get-verified — Seller verification

## Crawling guidance
Publicly crawlable: /, /marketplace, /listing/*, /fansigns, /about, /blog, /legit, /sold, /ranks, /badges, /get-verified
Requires auth (do not index): /dashboard, /messages, /orders, /account, /sell, /pancake/*

## Contact
support@larpings.com
